blocks.text: Account settings allow you to manage your account and customize various aspects of your account. You can modify or view your account settings from the Settings page in the Zscaler Multi-Tenant Portal for Partners.
Account settings provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Update and manage your account details such as email address, contact information, logo, reset password etc.
Manage subscription agreements, notifications and authentication.

blocks.text: On the Settings page, you can do the following:

blocks.item: Partner ID: The ID generated when you created your account with Zscaler.
Partner Type: The type of partner account.
